description: Source-of-truth manifest for all public observability signals emitted by Glassbox. CI validates that documentation tables and examples match this file.

prometheus_metrics.name: remote_node_last_response_timestamp_seconds
prometheus_metrics.description: Unix timestamp of last successful RPC response

progress_event_phases.name: fetch
progress_event_phases.description: Fetching the transaction envelope from the network

progress_event_phases.name: export
progress_event_phases.description: Writing trace or snapshot output files

progress_event_statuses.name: error
progress_event_statuses.description: Phase failed; error_code is always populated

stable_error_codes.description: Operation was cancelled by the user or context

maintenance.purpose: Companion guidance for maintainers editing this manifest. Describes each top-level key, how to add or update entries, and the exact validation commands. This object is documentation only and is not consumed by runtime code.

top_level_keys.purpose: Version of the manifest schema. Bump only when the shape of existing keys changes incompatibly; do not change it for additive documentation such as this maintenance object.

Every public Prometheus metric emitted by Glassbox. Each entry records name, type, labels, description, stability, and the docs that reference it. Metric names follow the conventions in internal/metrics (snake_case, unit suffix such as _seconds or _total, counters end in _total).
Ordered lifecycle phases emitted as progress events. Add a phase only when the implementation emits it; keep names lowercase and single-word.
Statuses a progress event may carry, with a terminal flag. Terminal statuses end a phase; error is always accompanied by an error_code.
Fields present on progress events. required marks fields always emitted; sensitive marks fields that must never carry secrets.
Error codes that callers may rely on. Each entry names the code, the phase it originates from (or * for any phase), and a short description.
Retired signals kept for reference. Empty when nothing is deprecated.

how_to_update: Add or update an entry in the relevant top-level array; do not reorder existing entries.
Preserve existing field names (name, type, labels, description, stability, documented_in) and JSON formatting (two-space indent, trailing newline).
Reference the documentation file that describes the signal in documented_in so CI can cross-check tables and examples.
Do not change schema_version for additive edits.

validation.purpose: Validates this manifest against the release schema; exits 0 on a valid release manifest.

invalid_prometheus_metric.expected_failure: scripts/verify-manifest.sh exits non-zero because the prometheus_metrics entry is missing the required 'name' field.
